headline: Clinton executive order directs federal agencies to address the use of illegally copied computer software.
what_it_does: This 1998 order deals with computer software piracy, meaning copying or using software without a proper license. Based on its title, it sets federal policy on preventing agencies from using pirated software. No summary was provided, so details such as specific rules or deadlines cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: They are likely expected to make sure the software they use is properly licensed.
Their products may get added protection against unlicensed copying within the federal government.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 30, 1998; exact effective date not stated in the source provided.
